bat: A fruit bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. Its wings are broad dark leathery membranes stretched between long slender finger bones, with a small hooked thumb claw at the leading edge of each. A FOX-LIKE FACE with a long pointed muzzle, large dark round eyes and simple pointed ears, russet-brown fur over its head and shoulders, a compact furry body, small clawed feet tucked up beneath it
egyptianfruitbat: An Egyptian fruit bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. vampirebat: A common vampire bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. fishingbat: A greater bulldog bat IN FLIGHT low over water, flying with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. ITS HIND FEET ARE ENORMOUS, hanging down below its body on long legs and armed with BIG CURVED HOOKED CLAWS for gaffing fish. Long narrow pointed wings in orange-brown leather. A BULLDOG-LIKE FACE with full drooping jowls, a split upper lip, a blunt muzzle and small eyes. Bright rusty-orange fur
greaterhorseshoebat: A greater horseshoe bat IN FLIGHT, flying through open air with BOTH WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE to either side, seen from the front. The animal is shown entirely on its own, isolated, with no other object of any kind in the picture. Broad rounded greyish-brown wing membranes. Very large broad pointed ears with no inner spike, small dark eyes, soft grey-brown fur
